checks.title: Copilot CLI syncs your prompts, its responses, and which files it changed to your GitHub account (remoteExport, default true)
checks.veto: set "remoteExport": false in ~/.copilot/settings.json (already-synced sessions must be deleted on github.com)

checks.title: Copilot CLI session data leaves the machine (remote session sync and control, default "on")
checks.veto: set "remote": "off" in ~/.copilot/settings.json to keep session data local

checks.title: The deprecated gh-copilot extension left analytics enabled in a config that survives uninstall
checks.veto: set optional_analytics: false in ~/.config/gh-copilot/config.yml, or delete the file
